from scipy.optimize import least_squares
t,x,v,a=df['t'].values,df['x'].values,df['v'].values,df['dv_dt'].values
models={
 'cos t + sqrtv + 1': lambda p: [np.sin(p[0]*v)*np.sqrt(x),np.cos(p[1]*t),np.sqrt(v),np.ones_like(t)],
 'cos t*sqrtv + 1': lambda p: [np.sin(p[0]*v)*np.sqrt(x),np.cos(p[1]*t)*np.sqrt(v),np.ones_like(t)],
 'cos t + sqrtv*t + 1': lambda p: [np.sin(p[0]*v)*np.sqrt(x),np.cos(p[1]*t),np.sqrt(v)*t,np.ones_like(t)],
 'cos t + sqrtv + t + 1': lambda p: [np.sin(p[0]*v)*np.sqrt(x),np.cos(p[1]*t),np.sqrt(v),t,np.ones_like(t)],
 'cos t*t + sqrtv + 1': lambda p: [np.sin(p[0]*v)*np.sqrt(x),np.cos(p[1]*t)*t,np.sqrt(v),np.ones_like(t)],
 'cos t*v + sqrtv + 1': lambda p: [np.sin(p[0]*v)*np.sqrt(x),np.cos(p[1]*t)*v,np.sqrt(v),np.ones_like(t)],
 'cos(p t)*sqrtv + t +1': lambda p: [np.sin(p[0]*v)*np.sqrt(x),np.cos(p[1]*t)*np.sqrt(v),t,np.ones_like(t)],
}
for nm,f in models.items():
    best=None
    for p1 in [0.5,1.0,2.0]:
        def r(p):
            M=np.column_stack(f(p))
            co=np.linalg.lstsq(M,a,rcond=None)[0]
            return M@co-a
        s=least_squares(r,[1.79,p1])
        e=np.mean(s.fun**2)/np.var(a)
        if best is None or e<best[0]: best=(e,s.x)
    print(nm,best)
